name: Yuanchao Wang
description: Yuanchao Wang works on reliable machine learning under distribution shift, from invariant learning and OOD detection to robust on-policy self-distillation.
bio: I am a Research Associate at New York University. I received my Master’s degree from the Pratt School of Engineering at Duke University in 2025.

My research focuses on reliable learning under distribution shift, heterogeneity, and unreliable samples. This work has evolved from shifts across environments to sample-level reliability, and more recently to training distributions generated by the model itself.
research_question: How can we identify the reliable boundary of a training distribution and construct robust learning signals?
research_text: I study this question through invariant learning, out-of-distribution detection, and LLM post-training. My recent work on on-policy self-distillation considers a training distribution that is generated by the student model and evolves throughout learning.
